title: Multiplexing: FDM and WDM
keyPoints: Multiplexing: simultaneous transmission of multiple signals across a single data link (slide 3).
FDM is an analog technique, used when link bandwidth (Hz) exceeds the combined bandwidths of the signals (slide 7).
Guard bands prevent overlapping; n channels need n − 1 guard bands (slides 9, 15).
WDM is an analog multiplexing technique for optical signals, using prisms (slides 22–23).
